title: Sources: Nuvacore, a six-month-old Sequoia-backed chip startup that's designing a new central processor for data centers, is raising funds at a ~$2.5B valuation (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Sources: Nuvacore, a six-month-old Sequoia-backed chip startup that's designing a new central processor for data centers, is raising funds at a ~$2.5B valuation — Six-month-old microchip startup Nuvacore, which does not yet have a product, is raising hundreds of millions of dollars …
